goal: Add the new AI surfaces: decisions as first-class records, Ask ✦ endpoint + sheet with honest 'I don't know' state, episodic time-indexed timeline + Memory view. Phase 1 built trust at the AI's output source; Phase 2 built the UI shell that exposes it; Phase 3 adds the new capabilities that make the system substantially more useful. The 'decisions' extraction prompt is conservative by design (always to suggestions queue, never auto-apply) because a wrongly-recorded decision implies a commitment you didn't make.
userProblem: The current system has no concept of 'decisions' as first-class records — commitments like 'ship target Friday Jun 26' or 'Mary is the final reviewer' are buried inside notes. The user can't query 'what did I commit to?' without searching notes. Ask ✦ mode (RAG over the workspace with grounded answers) is missing entirely. The system has no notion of an episode — a thread of activity spanning multiple entities — so the user can't ask 'what did I do last Tuesday afternoon?' The Memory view is a new surface that addresses all three gaps.
whyNow: Decisions + Ask ✦ + Memory are the new AI surfaces that justify the v5 redesign. Without them the new UI is a cleaner version of the same capability. With them, the user has: a queryable record of commitments (decisions), a conversational interface over their workspace (Ask ✦), and a chronological view of their activity (Memory). Phase 3 is the slice of the redesign that's most likely to be re-evaluated post-launch; the decision extraction precision target (≥85% on labeled corpus) is the success metric.

tasks.description: Build V5CaptureSheet.jsx as a modal sheet (web) or bottom sheet (mobile) that opens from the FAB. The sheet has a single multi-line input. tasks.title: Decisions as first-class records (extraction + schema + sheet)
tasks.description: Add a new entity type 'decision' that tracks explicit commitments. Schema: id, thread_id (FK entities.id), statement, context, decided_at, decided_by ('user' or 'agent:<name>'), source_note_id (FK entities.id), superseded_by (FK decisions.id, nullable). Extract from notes/tasks via prompt: 'only extract EXPLICIT commitments with named person and specific date or deliverable. Reject tentative language (maybe, we could, I think).' Decisions ALWAYS go to suggestions queue, never auto-apply (per §11.6 of 02-fresh-pass.md). UI: thread detail timeline shows ⚖ decision entries; thread header shows a 'decisions' count chip; new POST /api/v4/decisions creates manually. False positives are worse than false negatives — a wrongly-recorded decision implies a commitment. Conservative prompt + always-to-suggestions is the guardrail.

tasks.title: /api/v4/ask endpoint + V5AskSheet with honest 'I don't know' state
tasks.description: POST /api/v4/ask takes a question, runs hybrid search to retrieve top-k context, generates a grounded answer with citations. Response shape: {answer, citations: [{entity_id, snippet, relevance}], confidence: high|medium|low, caveats: [...], suggested_actions: [{type, label, payload}]}. When confidence is low or context is empty, return honest 'I don't have anything in the workspace that answers this' response with caveats explaining why. NEVER confabulate. Cache answers for 24h keyed on (question, top-k context hash). UI: V5AskSheet opens from the + Ask ✦ button in the top bar; shows the question, thinking state, then answer with citations. When confidence is low, the sheet shows the 'I don't know' state with a 'Capture starting point' action.

Confidence high requires ≥2 citations with relevance ≥0.7; medium is 1 citation or 2+ with relevance <0.7; low is 0 citations
Cache: 24h TTL keyed on sha256(question + top_k_context_hash); cache hit returns same response without re-running LLM
